name: Loving Your Body
overview: Scripture reveals that our bodies are fearfully and wonderfully made by God, reflecting His marvelous craftsmanship and inherent goodness in creation. From the declaration that all God made was very good to the affirmation that the Lord delights in His people, we see a divine affirmation of worth and value. Loving your body is rooted in recognizing it as part of God's good design and appreciating the high value He places on His creation and His people.
